note: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings, data loading pipelines, and evaluators for COCO object detection in MMDetection.
use_cases: Configure COCO dataset paths and annotations for object detection training
Define image preprocessing pipelines (resize, flip, pack inputs) for training
Define image preprocessing pipelines for validation and testing
Set up data loaders with batch sampling and aspect ratio batching
Configure COCO metric evaluators for bbox-based validation

examples.review_coco_detection_config: review the coco_detection.py config file to understand dataset settings and pipeline definitions
examples.summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the train_pipeline configuration including resize, random flip, and pack inputs steps
examples.summarize_test_pipeline: summarize the test_pipeline configuration including resize and pack inputs with meta keys
examples.review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader config to understand batch size, sampler, and dataset settings
examples.review_val_evaluator: review the val_evaluator config to understand COCO bbox metric evaluation settings
